workload.description: One import of 900 customer records, about one in twenty a respelling of another, as the import runs today.

language_or_algorithm.statement: Mostly the algorithm: every record is compared with every other, and the fingerprint of each is worked out again for every comparison. Grouping the records by fingerprint needs one fingerprint per record.

tried.description: The same import with the records grouped by fingerprint first; it returns the same pairs in the same order.

decision.reason: Grouping by fingerprint removes nearly all of the cost in Python. Whether anything is left to port is a question for the improved code.
